title: Thomas the little blue engine.
lines: Lots and lots of trains run on the island of Sodor.
Big trains, small trains, fast and slow trains.
One of those trains is Thomas.
Thomas is a little blue steam engine.
He has the number one on his side.
The boss of all the trains is the Fat Controller.
He wears a tall black hat.
Every morning the trains get a job.
Thomas, says the Fat Controller, today you'll take the milk to the farm.
And you must be on time.
He goes to the station with his little trucks.
The milk churns are loaded on.
On the way Thomas sees his friend Percy.
But he thinks about his job.
I have to deliver the milk.
A little further on he sees a cow on the tracks.
But the cow stays where she is.
He leads the cow away with a handful of grass.
I think I can, I think I can, puffs Thomas.
Then Percy comes up behind him.
Together they get to the top of the hill.
Thomas goes down the hill to the farm.
Now the children can drink milk with their breakfast.
That evening in the engine shed, where the trains sleep, the Fat Controller comes by.
But I couldn't do it alone, says Thomas.
Then you're both really useful engines.
Thomas and Percy whistle at the same time.
